headline: mtg advances to 18th as ARC-2 gold cutoff reaches 69.72

sections.text: mtg gained 3.48 to reach 69.31, climbing from 24th to 18th on the ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard in the past day.
The advance brings mtg closer to the provisional gold places. The last gold position is 16th, with the cutoff at 69.72. Medals are decided on the private leaderboard.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
